  fn execute_with_timeout(&self, mut cmd: Command) -> Result<Option<Output>> {\n488\t        let timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.timeout_secs);\n489\t\n490\t        // Spawn the process\n491\t None\n269\t        }\n270\t    }\n271\t\n272\t    /// Delete the entire trace directory.\n273\t    pub fn delete(&self) -> Result<()> {\n274\t        if self.trace_dir.exists() {\n275\t            std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.trace_dir).with_context(|| {\n276\t                format!(\n277\t                    \"failed to delete trace directory: {}\",\n278\t                    self.trace_dir.display()\n279\t                )\n280\t            })?;\n281\t        }\n282\t        Ok(())\n283\t    }\n284\t\n285\t    /// Prune trace data (keep metadata only).\n286\t    ///\n287\t    /// Deletes trace.jsonl, stdout.txt, stderr.txt, and test-output.txt, keeping only metadata.json.\n288\t    /// Updates the `pruned` flag in metadata.\n289\t    pub fn prune_trace_data(&self) -> Result<()> {\n290\t        if !self.enabled {\n291\t            return Ok(());\n292\t        }\n293\t\n294\t        // Delete trace data files.\n295\t        for file in std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n299\t                    .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n300\t            }\n301\t        }\n302\t\n303\t        // Update }\n316\t}\n317\t\n318\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n319\t// Trace format detection\n320\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n321\t\n322\t/// Detect trace format from agent adapter name.\n323\tpub fn detect_trace_format(agent_name: &str) -> TraceFormat {\n324\t    match agent_name {\n325\t        n if n.starts_with(\"claude-\") => TraceFormat::ClaudeJson,\n326\t        n if n.contains(\"codex\") || n.contains(\"openai\") => TraceFormat::OpenaiJsonl,\n327\t        n if n.contains(\"aider\") => TraceFormat::AiderMarkdown,\n328\t        _ => TraceFormat::RawText,\n329\t    }\n330\t}\n331\t\n332\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n333\t// Trace retention cleanup\n334\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n335\t\n336\t/// Cleanup result for trace retention.\n337\t#[derive(Debug, Default)]\n338\tpub struct TraceCleanupSummary {\n339\t    /// Number of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n340\t    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n341\t    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n342\t    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n343\t}\n344\t\n345\t/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n346\t///\n347\t/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n348\t/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\n349\tpub fn cleanup_traces(\n350\t    traces_dir: &Path,\n351\t    retention_days_failed: u32,\n352\t    retention_days_success: u32,\n353\t) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n354\t    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n355\t\n356\t    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n357\t        return Ok(summary);\n358\t    }\n359\t\n360\t    let now = SystemTime::now()\n361\t        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n362\t        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n363\t        .unwrap_or(0);\n364\t\n365\t    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n366\t    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n367\t        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n368\t    {\n369\t        let entry = match entry {\n370\t            Ok(e) => e,\n371\t            Err(_) => continue,\n372\t        };\n373\t\n374\t        let path = entry.path();\n375\t\n376\t        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n377\t        if !path.is_dir() {\n378\t            continue;\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n382\t        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n383\t        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n384\t            .exists()\n385\t            .then(|| {\n386\t                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n387\t                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n388\t            })\n389\t            .flatten();\n390\t\n391\t        let age_days = metadata\n392\t            .as_ref()\n393\t            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n394\t            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n395\t            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n396\t\n397\t        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n398\t        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n399\t\n400\t        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n401\t        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n402\t        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n403\t        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n404\t        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n405\t        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE]\n406\t            .iter()\n407\t            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n408\t\n409\t        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n410\t        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n411\t        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n412\t        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n413\t        let should_prune =\n414\t            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n415\t\n416\t        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n417\t        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n418\t        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n419\t            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n420\t                tracing::debug!(\n421\t                    path = %path.display(),\n422\t                    error = %e,\n423\t                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n424\t                );\n425\t            }\n426\t        }\n427\t\n428\t        if should_delete {\n429\t            // Delete entire trace directory.\n430\t            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n431\t                tracing::warn!(\n432\t                    path = %path.display(),\n433\t                    error = %e,\n434\t                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n435\t                );\n436\t            } else {\n437\t                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n438\t            }\n439\t        } else if should_prune {\n440\t            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n441\t            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n442\t                tracing::warn!(\n443\t                    path = %path.display(),\n444\t                    error = %e,\n445\t                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n446\t                );\n447\t            } else {\n448\t                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n449\t            }\n450\t        }\n451\t    }\n452\t\n453\t    Ok(summary)\n454\t}\n455\t\n456\t/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n457\t/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\n458\tfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n459\t    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n460\t    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n461\t        return Ok(());\n462\t    }\n463\t\n464\t    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n465\t    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n466\t        if !metadata.pruned {\n467\t            metadata.pruned = true;\n468\t            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n469\t            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n470\t            tracing::debug!(\n471\t                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n472\t                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n473\t            );\n474\t        }\n475\t    }\n476\t    Ok(())\n477\t}\n478\t\n479\t/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n480\t///\n481\t/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n482\t/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n483\t/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n484\t/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n485\t/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\n486\tfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n487\t    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n488\t    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n489\t    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n490\t    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n491\t    if metadata_path.exists() {\n492\t        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n493\t        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n494\t            metadata.pruned = true;\n495\t            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n496\t            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n497\t        }\n498\t    }\n499\t\n500\t    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n501\t    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n502\t    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n503\t    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n504\t        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n505\t        if path.exists() {\n506\t            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n507\t                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n508\t        }\n509\t    }\n510\t\n511\t    Ok(())\n512\t}\n513\t\n514\tuse std::time::SystemTime;\n515\t\n516\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n517\t// Tests\n518\t// }\n316\t}\n317\t\n318\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n319\t// Trace format detection\n320\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n321\t\n322\t/// Detect trace format from agent adapter name.\n323\tpub fn detect_trace_format(agent_name: &str) -> TraceFormat {\n324\t    match agent_name {\n325\t        n if n.starts_with(\"claude-\") => TraceFormat::ClaudeJson,\n326\t        n if n.contains(\"codex\") || n.contains(\"openai\") => ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n333\t// Trace retention cleanup\n334\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n335\t\n336\t/// Cleanup result for trace retention.\n337\t#[derive(Debug, Default)]\n338\tpub struct TraceCleanupSummary {\n339\t    /// Number of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n340\t    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n341\t    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n342\t    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n343\t}\n344\t\n345\t/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n346\t///\n347\t/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n348\t/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\n349\tpub fn cleanup_traces(\n350\t    traces_dir: &Path,\n351\t    retention_days_failed: u32,\n352\t    retention_days_success: u32,\n353\t) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n354\t    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n355\t\n356\t    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n357\t        return Ok(summary);\n358\t    }\n359\t\n360\t    let now = SystemTime::now()\n361\t        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n362\t        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n363\t        .unwrap_or(0);\n364\t\n365\t    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n366\t    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n367\t        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n368\t    {\n369\t        let entry = match entry {\n370\t            Ok(e) => e,\n371\t            Err(_) => continue,\n372\t        };\n373\t\n374\t        let path = entry.path();\n375\t\n376\t        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n377\t        if !path.is_dir() {\n378\t            continue;\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n382\t        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n383\t        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n384\t            .exists()\n385\t            .then(|| {\n386\t                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n387\t                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n388\t            })\n389\t            .flatten();\n390\t\n391\t        let age_days = metadata\n392\t            .as_ref()\n393\t            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n394\t            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n395\t            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n396\t\n397\t        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n398\t        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n399\t\n400\t        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n401\t        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n402\t        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n403\t        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n404\t        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n405\t        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE]\n406\t            .iter()\n407\t            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n408\t\n409\t        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n410\t        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n411\t        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n412\t        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n413\t        let should_prune =\n414\t            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n415\t\n416\t        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n417\t        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n418\t        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n419\t            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n420\t                tracing::debug!(\n421\t                    path = %path.display(),\n422\t                    error = %e,\n423\t                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n424\t                );\n425\t            }\n426\t        }\n427\t\n428\t        if should_delete {\n429\t            // Delete entire trace directory.\n430\t            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n431\t                tracing::warn!(\n432\t                    path = %path.display(),\n433\t                    error = %e,\n434\t                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n435\t                );\n436\t            } else {\n437\t                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n438\t            }\n439\t        } else if should_prune {\n440\t            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n441\t            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n442\t                tracing::warn!(\n443\t                    path = %path.display(),\n444\t                    error = %e,\n445\t                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n446\t                );\n447\t            } else {\n448\t                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n449\t            }\n450\t        }\n451\t    }\n452\t\n453\t    Ok(summary)\n454\t}\n455\t\n456\t/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n457\t/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\n458\tfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n459\t    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n460\t    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n461\t        return Ok(());\n462\t    }\n463\t\n464\t    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n465\t    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n466\t        if !metadata.pruned {\n467\t            metadata.pruned = true;\n468\t            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n469\t            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n470\t            tracing::debug!(\n471\t                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n472\t                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n473\t            );\n474\t        }\n475\t    }\n476\t    Ok(())\n477\t}\n478\t\n479\t/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n480\t///\n481\t/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n482\t/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n483\t/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n484\t/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n485\t/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\n486\tfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n487\t    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n488\t    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n489\t    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n490\t    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n491\t    if metadata_path.exists() {\n492\t        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n493\t        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n494\t            metadata.pruned = true;\n495\t            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n496\t            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n497\t        }\n498\t    }\n499\t\n500\t    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n501\t    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n502\t    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n503\t    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n504\t        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n505\t        if path.exists() {\n506\t            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n507\t                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n508\t        }\n509\t    }\n510\t\n511\t    Ok(())\n512\t}\n513\t\n514\tuse std::time::SystemTime;\n515\t\n516\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n517\t// Tests\n518\t// Traces are stored\n//! in `.beads/traces/<bead-id>/` with structured metadata.\n//!\n//! ## Trace Retention Policy\n//!\n//! - **Failed beads**: 30 days (full trace retained)\n//! - **Successful beads**: metadata-only after 7 days (trace data pruned)\n//!\n//! ## Directory Structure\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! .beads/traces/<bead-id>/\n//! ├── trace.jsonl     # Structured trace events (one JSON object per line)\n//! ├── stdout.txt      # Raw stdout from agent process\n//! ├── stderr.txt      # Raw stderr from agent process\n//! ├── test-output.txt # Processed test output (for test runs)\n//! └── metadata.json   # Timing, tokens, cost, template version\n//! ```\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::UNIX_EPOCH;\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n\nuse crate::cargo_test::TestMetrics;\nuse crate::sanitize::Sanitizer;\nuse crate::types::BeadId;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Constants\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Test output file    /// Trace capture timestamp.\n    pub captured_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n    /// Adapter-specific trace format.\n    pub trace_format: TraceFormat,\n    /// Whether the trace data has been pruned ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trace storage\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Manages trace storage for a bead execution.\npub struct TraceCapture {\n    /// Trace directory for this bead (`.beads/traces/<bead-id>`).\n    trace_dir: PathBuf,\n    /// Whether trace capture is enabled.\n    enabled: bool,\n    /// Optional sanitizer applied to all content before writing to disk.\n    sanitizer: Option<Arc<Sanitizer>>,\n}\n\nimpl TraceCapture {\n    /// Create a new trace capture for a bead without sanitization.\n    ///\n    /// `beads_root` is the workspace directory containing `.beads/`.\n    /// Returns `None` if trace capture is disabled.\n    pub fn new(bead_id: &BeadId, beads_root: &Path) -> Option<Self> {\n        Self::new_with_sanitizer(bead_id, beads_root, None)\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new trace capture for a bead with an optional sanitizer.\n    ///\n    /// When `sanitizer` is `Some`, all trace content is sanitized synchronously\n    /// before writing to disk (no unsanitized window on disk).\n    pub fn new_with_sanitizer(\n        bead_id: &BeadId,\n        beads_root: &Path,\n        sanitizer: Option<Arc<Sanitizer>>,\n    ) -> Option<Self> {\n        let trace_dir = beads_root\n            .join(\".beads\")\n            .join(\"traces\")\n            .join(bead_id.as_ref());\n\n        // Create the trace directory.\n        if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&trace_dir) {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                bead_id = %bead_id,\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                error = %e,\n                \"failed to create trace directory, trace capture disabled\"\n            );\n            return None;\n        }\n\n        Some(TraceCapture {\n            trace_dir,\n            enabled: true,\n            sanitizer,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Get the trace directory path.\n    pub fn trace_dir(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.trace_dir\n    }\n\n    /// Write stdout to `stdout.txt`.\n    ///\n    /// Content is sanitized before writing if a sanitizer is configured.\n    pub fn write_stdout(&self, stdout: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let content = self.sanitize(stdout);\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"stdout.txt\");\n        std::fs::write(&path, content.as_bytes())\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write stdout trace: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write stderr to `stderr.txt`.\n    ///\n    /// Content is sanitized before writing if a sanitizer is configured.\n    pub fn write_stderr(&self, stderr: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let content = self.sanitize(stderr);\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"stderr.txt\");\n        std::fs::write(&path, content.as_bytes())\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write stderr trace: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write test output to `test-output.txt`.\n    ///\n    /// This stores processed/formatted test output (e.g., parsed cargo test results).\n    /// Content is sanitized before writing if a sanitizer is configured.\n    pub fn write_test_output(&self, output: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let content = self.sanitize(output);\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(TEST_OUTPUT_FILE);\n        std::fs::write(&path, content.as_bytes())\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write test output: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write structured trace JSONL to `trace.jsonl`.\n    ///\n    /// Each line should be a valid JSON object. Lines are sanitized before\n    /// writing if a sanitizer is configured.\n    pub fn write_trace_jsonl(&self, trace_lines: &[String]) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled || trace_lines.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"trace.jsonl\");\n        let joined = trace_lines.join(\"\\n\");\n        let content = self.sanitize(&joined);\n        std::fs::write(&path, content.as_bytes())\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write trace JSONL: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Sanitize text if a sanitizer is configured; otherwise return as-is.\n    fn sanitize<'a>(&self, text: &'a str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'a, str> {\n        match &self.sanitizer {\n            Some(s) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(s.sanitize(text)),\n            None => std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(text),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Write metadata to `metadata.json`.\n    pub fn write_metadata(&self, metadata: &TraceMetadata) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let json =\n            serde_json::to_string_pretty(metadata).context(\"failed to serialize trace metadata\")?;\n        std::fs::write(&path, json)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write metadata: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write test metrics to `test_metrics.json`.\n    ///\n    /// This stores cargo test execution metrics including exit code,\n    /// duration, and output sizes for later analysis.\n    pub fn write_test_metrics(&self, metrics: &TestMetrics) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"test_metrics.json\");\n        let json =\n            serde_json::to_string_pretty(metrics).context(\"failed to serialize test metrics\")?;\n        std::fs::write(&path, json)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write test metrics: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write compilation errors to `compilation_errors.json`.\n    ///\n    /// This stores detailed compilation error information including error codes,\n    /// variant classifications, and file locations for later analysis.\n    pub fn write_compilation_errors(\n        &self,\n        errors: &[crate::cargo_test::CompilationError],\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled || errors.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"compilation_errors.json\");\n        let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(errors)\n            .context(\"failed to serialize compilation errors\")?;\n        std::fs::write(&path, json)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write compilation errors: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Finalize the trace and return the trace directory path.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `None` if trace capture was disabled.\n    pub fn finalize(self) -> Option<PathBuf> {\n        if self.enabled {\n            Some(self.trace_dir)\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Delete the entire trace directory.\n    pub fn delete(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.trace_dir.exists() {\n            std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.trace_dir).with_context(|| {\n                format!(\n                    \"failed to delete trace directory: {}\",\n                    self.trace_dir.display()\n                )\n            })?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Prune trace data (keep metadata only).\n    ///\n    /// Deletes trace.jsonl, stdout.txt, stderr.txt, and test-output.txt, keeping only metadata.json.\n    /// Updates the `pruned` flag in metadata.\n    pub fn prune_trace_data(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Delete trace data files.\n        for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n            let path = self.trace_dir.join(file);\n            if path.exists() {\n                std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n                    .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Update metadata to mark as pruned.\n        let metadata_path = self.trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        if metadata_path.exists() {\n            let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n            if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n                metadata.pruned = true;\n                let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n                std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trace format detection\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Detect trace format from agent adapter name.\npub fn detect_trace_format(agent_name: &str) -> TraceFormat {\n    match agent_name {\n        n if n.starts_with(\"claude-\") => TraceFormat::ClaudeJson,\n        n if n.contains(\"codex\") || n.contains(\"openai\") => TraceFormat::OpenaiJsonl,\n        n if n.contains(\"aider\") => TraceFormat::AiderMarkdown,\n        _ => TraceFormat::RawText,\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trace retention cleanup\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Cleanup result for trace retention.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct TraceCleanupSummary {\n    /// Number of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n}\n\n/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n///\n/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\npub fn cleanup_traces(\n    traces_dir: &Path,\n    retention_days_failed: u32,\n    retention_days_success: u32,\n) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n\n    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n        return Ok(summary);\n    }\n\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n    {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let path = entry.path();\n\n        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n        if !path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n            .exists()\n            .then(|| {\n                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n            })\n            .flatten();\n\n        let age_days = metadata\n            .as_ref()\n            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n\n        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n\n        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE]\n            .iter()\n            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n\n        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n        let should_prune =\n            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n\n        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if should_delete {\n            // Delete entire trace directory.\n            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n            }\n        } else if should_prune {\n            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(summary)\n}\n\n/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\nfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n        if !metadata.pruned {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n///\n/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\nfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if metadata_path.exists() {\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n        if path.exists() {\n            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nuse std::time::SystemTime;\n\n// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\npub fn cleanup_traces(\n    traces_dir: &Path,\n    retention_days_failed: u32,\n    retention_days_success: u32,\n) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n\n    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n        return Ok(summary);\n    }\n\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n    {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let path = entry.path();\n\n        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n        if !path.is_dir() serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n            })\n            .flatten();\n\n        let age_days = metadata\n            .as_ref()\n            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n\n        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n\n        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n        // This This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\nfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n        if !metadata.pruned {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n///\n/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\npub fn cleanup_traces(\n    traces_dir: &Path,\n    retention_days_failed: u32,\n    retention_days_success: u32,\n) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n\n    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n        return Ok(summary);\n    }\n\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n    {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let path = entry.path();\n\n        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n        if !path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n            .exists()\n            .then(|| {\n                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n            })\n            .flatten();\n\n        let age_days = metadata\n            .as_ref()\n            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n\n        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n\n        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE]\n            .iter()\n            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n\n        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n        let should_prune =\n            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n\n        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if should_delete {\n            // Delete entire trace directory.\n            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n            }\n        } else if should_prune {\n            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(summary)\n}\n\n/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\nfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n        if !metadata.pruned {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n///\n/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\nfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if metadata_path.exists() {\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n        if path.exists() {\n            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nuse std::time::SystemTime;\n\n// .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write test output: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write structured trace JSONL to `trace.jsonl`.\n    ///\n    /// Each line should be a valid JSON object. Lines are sanitized before\n    /// writing if a sanitizer is configured.\n    pub fn write_trace_jsonl(&self, trace_lines: &[String]) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled || trace_lines.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"trace.jsonl\");\n        let joined = trace_lines.join(\"\\n\");\n        let content = self.sanitize(&joined);\n        std::fs::write(&path, content.as_bytes())\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write trace JSONL: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Sanitize text if a sanitizer is configured; otherwise return as-is.\n    fn sanitize<'a>(&self, text: &'a str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'a, str> {\n        match &self.sanitizer {\n            Some(s) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(s.sanitize(text)),\n            None => std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(text),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Write metadata to `metadata.json`.\n    pub fn write_metadata(&self, metadata: &TraceMetadata) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let json =\n            serde_json::to_string_pretty(metadata).context(\"failed to serialize trace metadata\")?;\n        std::fs::write(&path, json)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write metadata: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write test metrics to `test_metrics.json`.\n    ///\n    /// This stores cargo test execution metrics including exit code,\n    /// duration, and output sizes for later analysis.\n    pub fn write_test_metrics(&self, metrics: &TestMetrics) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"test_metrics.json\");\n        let json =\n            serde_json::to_string_pretty(metrics).context(\"failed to serialize test metrics\")?;\n        std::fs::write(&path, json)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write test metrics: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Write compilation errors to `compilation_errors.json`.\n    ///\n    /// This stores detailed compilation error information including error codes,\n    /// variant classifications, and file locations for later analysis.\n    pub fn write_compilation_errors(\n        &self,\n        errors: &[crate::cargo_test::CompilationError],\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled || errors.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let path = self.trace_dir.join(\"compilation_errors.json\");\n        let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(errors)\n            .context(\"failed to serialize compilation errors\")?;\n        std::fs::write(&path, json)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write compilation errors: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Finalize the trace and return the trace directory path.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `None` if trace capture was disabled.\n    pub fn finalize(self) -> Option<PathBuf> {\n        if self.enabled {\n            Some(self.trace_dir)\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Delete the entire trace directory.\n    pub fn delete(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.trace_dir.exists() {\n            std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.trace_dir).with_context(|| {\n                format!(\n                    \"failed to delete trace directory: {}\",\n                    self.trace_dir.display()\n                )\n            })?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Prune trace data (keep metadata only).\n    ///\n    /// Deletes trace.jsonl, stdout.txt, stderr.txt, and test-output.txt, keeping only metadata.json.\n    /// Updates the `pruned` flag in metadata.\n    pub fn prune_trace_data(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Delete trace data files.\n        for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n            let path = self.trace_dir.join(file);\n            if path.exists() {\n                std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n                    .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Update metadata to mark as pruned.\n        let metadata_path = self.trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        if metadata_path.exists() {\n            let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n            if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n                metadata.pruned = true;\n                let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n                std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trace format detection\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Detect trace format from agent adapter name.\npub fn detect_trace_format(agent_name: &str) -> TraceFormat {\n    match agent_name {\n        n if n.starts_with(\"claude-\") => TraceFormat::ClaudeJson,\n        n if n.contains(\"codex\") || n.contains(\"openai\") => TraceFormat::OpenaiJsonl,\n        n if n.contains(\"aider\") => TraceFormat::AiderMarkdown,\n        _ => TraceFormat::RawText,\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trace retention cleanup\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Cleanup result for trace retention.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct TraceCleanupSummary {\n    /// Number of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n}\n\n/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n///\n/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\npub fn cleanup_traces(\n    traces_dir: &Path,\n    retention_days_failed: u32,\n    retention_days_success: u32,\n) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n\n    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n        return Ok(summary);\n    }\n\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n    {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let path = entry.path();\n\n        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n        if !path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n            .exists()\n            .then(|| {\n                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n            })\n            .flatten();\n\n        let age_days = metadata\n            .as_ref()\n            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n\n        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n\n        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE]\n            .iter()\n            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n\n        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n        let should_prune =\n            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n\n        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if should_delete {\n            // Delete entire trace directory.\n            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n            }\n        } else if should_prune {\n            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(summary)\n}\n\n/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\nfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n        if !metadata.pruned {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n///\n/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\nfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if metadata_path.exists() {\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n        if path.exists() {\n            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nuse std::time::SystemTime;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Cleanup result for trace retention.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct TraceCleanupSummary {\n    /// Number of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n}\n\n/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n///\n/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\npub fn cleanup_traces(\n    traces_dir: &Path,\n    retention_days_failed: u32,\n    retention_days_success: u32,\n) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n\n    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n        return Ok(summary);\n    }\n\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n    {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let path = entry.path();\n\n        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n        if !path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n            .exists()\n            .then(|| {\n                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n            })\n            .flatten();\n\n        let age_days = metadata\n            .as_ref()\n            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n\n        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n\n        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE]\n            .iter()\n            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n\n        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n        let should_prune =\n            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n\n        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if should_delete {\n            // Delete entire trace directory.\n            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n            }\n        } else if should_prune {\n            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(summary)\n}\n\n/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\nfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n        if !metadata.pruned {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n///\n/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\nfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if metadata_path.exists() {\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n        if path.exists() {\n of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n}\n\n/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n///\n/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\npub fn cleanup_traces(\n    traces_dir: &Path,\n    retention_days_failed: u32,\n    retention_days_success: u32,\n) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n\n    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n        return Ok(summary);\n    }\n\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n    {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let path = entry.path();\n\n        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n        if !path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n            .exists()\n            .then(|| {\n                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n            })\n            .flatten();\n\n        let age_days = metadata\n            .as_ref()\n            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n\n        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n\n        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE]\n            .iter()\n            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n\n        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n        let should_prune =\n            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n\n        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if should_delete {\n            // Delete entire trace directory.\n            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n            }\n        } else if should_prune {\n            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(summary)\n}\n\n/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\nfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n        if !metadata.pruned {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n///\n/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\nfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if metadata_path.exists() {\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\", TEST_OUTPUT_FILE] {\n        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n        if path.exists() {\n            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nuse std::time::SystemTime;\n\n//
